newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle quiet, sales light - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle quiet, sales light - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Friday were quiet, with only minimal trading of off-quality cattle reported, market sources said.
About 500 head of cattle with below-average yields were sold at $70.00 per cwt delivered to the plant on a live basis.

There was no activity for cattle on a dressed basis. The average price this week was estimated at $113.50/dressed, the sources said. Prices this week topped at $115.00 on Wednesday, but slipped to $113.50 to $114.00 on Thursday. Last week's top price was $116.00. About 49,000 head traded this week.
Showlists next week seen near steady at 50,000 head.
